name: Giant Eagle
traits: Tyler Kamstra's DMs Guild player conversion for 2014 fifth edition, using the v2 printed traits.
Medium Beast. Strength +1 and Dexterity +1. Walk 10 ft. and fly 60 ft. Flight requires staying out of medium and heavy armor. Giant eagles are naturally intelligent and generally neutral good.
Keen Sight grants advantage on sight-based Wisdom (Perception) checks. Lack of hands prevents wielding weapons, using shields, or operating items that need manipulation.
Talons deal 1d8 piercing on an unarmed hit. Use Strength or Dexterity for both rolls. The talons count as a finesse weapon for qualifying features, including Sneak Attack.
Speaks, reads, and writes Giant Eagle. Understands, reads, and writes Common and Auran. Giant Eagle is the only language it can speak.

name: Giant Frog
traits: Tyler Kamstra's DMs Guild player conversion for 2014 fifth edition, using the v2 printed traits.
Medium awakened Beast, typically neutral. Strength +2 and Dexterity +1. Walk and swim 30 ft. Breathes air and water.

Unarmed bites deal 1d8 piercing, using Strength or Dexterity for the attack and damage. The bite counts as a finesse weapon for qualifying features. After an unarmed hit made with the Attack action, a bonus action can initiate a grapple against the creature hit.
Cannot wield weapons, use shields, or operate items that need hands. Speaks, reads, and writes Common.

name: Giant Hyena
traits: Tyler Kamstra's DMs Guild player conversion for 2014 fifth edition, using the v2 printed traits.
Medium awakened Beast, typically neutral. Strength +2 and Constitution +1. Walk 30 ft. Its unarmed bite deals 1d8 piercing.
Rampage. After reducing a creature to 0 HP with a melee attack on your turn, you may spend your bonus action to move up to half your speed and make a bite attack.
Cannot wield weapons, use shields, or operate items that need hands. Speaks, reads, and writes Common.

name: Giant Octopus
traits: Tyler Kamstra's DMs Guild player conversion for 2014 fifth edition, using the v2 printed traits.
Medium awakened Beast, typically neutral. Strength +2. Walk 10 ft. and swim 60 ft. Breathes underwater only, with a one-hour breath hold. Darkvision extends 60 ft. and shows darkness in grayscale.

Amorphous. Moves through openings as narrow as 1 inch without squeezing and cannot wear armor. Its tentacles can use most objects, but it cannot wield weapons or shields. Its unarmed tentacle strike deals 1d8 bludgeoning.

Underwater camouflage grants advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks. Underwater, release ink in a 20-ft. radius to heavily obscure the area for 1 minute or until dispersed by a significant current. May Dash as a bonus action immediately afterward. Regains ink after a short or long rest.
